answer: Sustained attention escrow. An identity may send transactions only while its rolling attention reserve stays above threshold. Reserve decays continuously and is refilled by answering short, unpredictable prompts within tight deadlines; a miss sends a ripple through the reserve and freezes outbound actions until refilled. Prompts wander across timing and modalities. Some include pigment-matching visual checks, forcing per-identity perceptual work, so one worker cannot serve many identities whose deadlines overlap.
